items.title: 56712_Cootie Williams oral history interview
items.q: Yeah. I'm sitting right next to Bobby, so Bobby knows I'm afraid.

ctx.x: Bobby knew you were scared, then?
Yeah. I'm sitting right next to Bobby, so Bobby knows I'm afraid.
Well, isn't that funny. Well, after all, I mean -- well, maybe they didn't know that that was the arrangement.
